title: UAP disclosure: records, advocacy, and testimony
dek: What public reporting establishes about the disclosure process—and where extraordinary claims still outrun the record.
summary: Government records, institutional reporting, and congressional activity establish an active UAP disclosure debate. They do not independently establish claims of non-human technology, which remain unverified in the sources reviewed here.
ai_disclosure: Local AI assisted with source grouping, summarization, and connection suggestions. A human reviewed the public record, wording, citations, and publication state. AI output is not treated as evidence.
